metadata.name: Jiang Xiao Liu Ren full-dimension logic library
metadata.structure: Earth palaces - Heaven stars - Human relatives - Spirits - clean rules
metadata.description: Sheng/ke modules are trimmed to core mappings for direct program lookup.

da_an.name: Da An
da_an.desc: Da An favors settled affairs; seek plans in the east. Slow, steady work; wait for ripeness.

liu_lian.name: Liu Lian
liu_lian.desc: Liu Lian makes matters hard to finish; timing stays unclear. Complexity and review; patch the leaks.

su_xi.name: Su Xi
su_xi.desc: Su Xi brings news to the door; seek wealth toward the south. Fast messages; good for rank and exams.

chi_kou.name: Chi Kou
chi_kou.desc: Chi Kou rules disputes; official trouble wears you down. High pressure; set a defensive boundary.

xiao_ji.name: Xiao Ji
xiao_ji.desc: Xiao Ji is the gentlest luck; helpers come from the north. Good for negotiation and connection.

kong_wang.name: Kong Wang
kong_wang.desc: Kong Wang leaves matters unfinished; plans stall halfway. Guard against deceit; pause and reflect.

mu_xing.name: Wood Star
mu_xing.desc: Planning and first growth. The matter is germinating or still young.

huo_xing.name: Fire Star
huo_xing.desc: Energy spreading outward. The matter is loud; publicity helps.

tu_xing.name: Earth Star
tu_xing.desc: Implementation and accumulation. The work is hands-on; depth wins.

jin_xing.name: Metal Star
jin_xing.desc: Results and boundaries. Time to subtract and set rules.

shui_xing.name: Water Star
shui_xing.desc: Strategy and adjustment. The matter keeps shifting; solve it by adapting.

tian_kong.name: Sky Void
tian_kong.desc: Variables and waste. Blind spots, or no real progress yet.

fu_mu.name: Parents
fu_mu.desc: Legitimacy and the external support system.

xiong_di.name: Sibling
xiong_di.desc: Peers: helpers and those who take a cut.

zi_sun.name: Child
zi_sun.desc: The blessing star. It controls pressure and stands for vitality.

qi_cai.name: Wealth
qi_cai.focus: Input versus output and material control
qi_cai.desc: What the querent wants to command, and the final yield.

guan_gui.name: Officer
guan_gui.desc: A double edge: career height and threat together.

shen_gong.name: Self
shen_gong.objects: One's own state and inner will
shen_gong.desc: The final bearer of every generation and control relation.

qing_long.name: Qinglong
qing_long.desc: Joy, noble help, and salary. The strongest booster.

zhu_que.name: Zhuque
zhu_que.desc: Speech, papers, and messages. Good for publicity; also quarrels.

gou_chen.name: Gouchen
gou_chen.desc: Delay and entanglement. Hard to leave the matter behind.

teng_she.name: Tengshe
teng_she.desc: Fright, change, and doubt. The mind will not settle.

bai_hu.name: Baihu
bai_hu.desc: Pressure, loss, and clash. Sudden calamity.

xuan_wu.name: Xuanwu
xuan_wu.desc: Hidden moves, theft, and loss. People working behind you.

5_zhi.label: Earthly branches: hours and wu xing
